quick_skim.title: TorchTPU - A Hybrid Eager/Compiled Architecture for Native PyTorch Execution on TPU
quick_skim.abstract: TorchTPU is an open-source collaboration between Google and Meta that introduces a native and principled PyTorch backend for Google TPUs. It enables seamless out-of-the-box model execution and TPU migration while delivering industry-competitive inference and training performance through eager execution optimizations, torch.compile integration, and native hardware acceleration.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: TorchTPU is an open-source native PyTorch backend for Google TPUs combining eager execution optimizations, torch.compile integration and hardware acceleration for competitive inference and training.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 论文针对PyTorch模型在TPU上缺乏原生、开箱即用执行路径的问题，提出TorchTPU，这是Google与Meta合作的开源PyTorch TPU后端。它结合即时执行优化、torch.compile集成与原生硬件加速，实现模型无缝迁移与编译执行。在推理与训练任务上取得具竞争力的性能。该工作展示了深度学习框架与专用加速器编译栈深度集成的可行模式。
